title: AFFLIB through 3.7.22 Heap Out-of-Bounds Write in af_get_page
description: CVE-2026-119601 is a heap out-of-bounds write vulnerability in AFFLIB version 3.0, specifically in the af_get_page function. This type of flaw can lead to memory corruption, potentially causing crashes or enabling further exploitation. No CVSS score or detailed impact information is provided.
